title: Maya urban life develops at Tikal
summary: Tikal’s temples, palaces, plazas and surrounding dwellings preserve a long sequence of Maya urban life. The site lay within a forest environment in present-day northern Guatemala.

claims.text: Tikal’s temples, palaces, plazas and surrounding dwellings preserve a long sequence of Maya urban life. The site lay within a forest environment in present-day northern Guatemala.
Approximate settlement sequence through the urban decline around 900 CE.

Ceremonial architecture is only part of the settlement. Including residential surroundings helps connect monumental sites with the communities that built and maintained them, while avoiding a claim that Maya history ended with this city’s decline.
